summary: Max Verstappen won the Mexico City Grand Prix from P5 on the grid, 0.8s ahead of Lewis Hamilton, with Kimi Antonelli completing the podium.
Liam Lawson made the biggest climb, from P22 to P7.
Pierre Gasly had a day to forget, dropping from P9 to P17.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag, 2 safety cars and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised LEC (5 second time penalty), RUS (10 second time penalty), PER (5 second time penalty) and HUL (10 second time penalty).
There were 67 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 119 points over Max Verstappen.
